problemSigns.sign: Opener hums but door doesn't move
problemSigns.detail: The motor runs, but the door remains stationary. This can indicate a stripped gear or broken drive train component.

problemSigns.sign: Door reverses before touching the floor
problemSigns.detail: The door starts to close, then opens back up. This often points to a safety sensor issue or incorrect force settings.
Your opener does not react to commands from remotes or the wall keypad. This may be a logic board or antenna problem.
The small lights on your safety sensors near the bottom of the track are blinking. This signals a blockage or misalignment.

problemSigns.sign: Trolley moves but door stays down
problemSigns.detail: The trolley glides along the rail, but the door itself does not engage. The disconnect arm or carriage may be broken.
